title: UCLA Campus Dickson Plaza, Kinsey Hall Crowd - Vintage 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A square snapshot captured in March 1966 showing a large gathering of students and spectators seated on the lawn of Dickson Plaza on the UCLA campus. In the background rises the Romanesque Revival brick facade and tower of Kinsey Hall (now Kaplan Hall), designed by Allison & Allison. The crowd is assembled outdoors under an open sky for a campus convocation, Charter Day ceremony, or rally during a pivotal era of collegiate activism and expansion in the mid-1960s.
